expeditions.name: Milked By Hand
expeditions.description: The hillside dairy, the hour before the tanker comes. Nothing up there is finished off by machine — it has to be done by hand, and she is not to stop until it is empty.

expeditions.name: Up To Her Thighs
expeditions.description: Into the bog for the one hour the water drops. She wades in to the thigh, brings out whatever the swamp hands over, and does not complain about what it does to her clothes — it has taken payment in complaining girls before.

expeditions.name: The Hour It Takes
expeditions.description: Into the treeline to negotiate passage for the wagon train. Whatever lives in there will not take coin, will not take grain, and has never been talked out of taking a girl for the hour instead — so she goes in and gives it the hour.

expeditions.name: Low-Hanging Fruit
expeditions.description: Into the orchard for the three hours before sunrise. Everything worth taking grows low, comes off by hand, and is finished on the knees — she works the row that way, and the farmer keeps only girls who clear it unaided.

expeditions.name: Elbow Deep
expeditions.description: Down the new shaft for the night shift. Three hours, no breaks, and she will be elbow deep in it before the first one is done — the crew above bores without stopping and does not ask, and nothing on that rig is built for comfort.

expeditions.name: Standing Orders
expeditions.description: Work the circus troupe for the three hours before the tent opens. Nothing in this valley stands up on its own and they are the worst of it — she takes them one at a time, and anyone who goes soft on her answers to her for it.

expeditions.name: The Flooded Cellar
expeditions.description: Down the sinkhole for six hours of free-diving in the dark. There is a cellar down there belonging to a house nobody will admit to remembering, and the water is cold enough that she is out of everything she owns in two minutes.

expeditions.name: Answer For The Dead
expeditions.description: Stand at the far end of the grave wall while the keeper reads every name out loud, and answer for the ones who cannot. Keep answering once the row is no longer empty — some of them come back wanting more than an answer.

expeditions.name: On The Clock
expeditions.description: Out on the hill road to work the night — one booking after the next, every camp along the switchbacks taking whoever is still on her feet. On the clock from the gate, payment up front, and nobody finishes before she does.

expeditions.name: Bad Dragon
expeditions.description: Into the rolling hills to search for an object the foothills have officially declared does not exist. If she finds it, she is not to try it on and not to let it enter her, however nicely it asks.
